name: Ocean Elite
description: Reunion Ocean Elite is a charming 2-bedroom villa offering direct beach access. It comes with a fully equipped kitchen and essential amenities like a fridge, WiFi, geyser, and AC. The villa features a spacious lawn that leads directly to the beach. One of the bedrooms boasts a beautiful beach view and a private balcony. The property also has generator backup to ensure uninterrupted power.

name: Ocean Manor
description: Reunion Ocean Manor features 2 BHK on the first floor and 2 independent one-bedroom halls on the ground floor. On the first floor, one bedroom is sea-facing and the other is river-facing. The living area has a huge beach-facing balcony. One bedroom hall on the ground floor has a living room with a sea-facing bedroom and balcony. There is a lawn with beach access through scenic rock beds. All basic amenities are available with generator power backup. Reunion Ocean Manor (Dreams) offers a cozy 1BHK on the ground floor with a direct beach view from the bedroom and immediate access to the shore, providing an intimate and relaxing setting.

name: Ocean Givaah
description: Reunion Ocean Givaah is a luxurious 3BHK beachside property in Udupi, perfect for families seeking a serene coastal retreat. The villa features spacious, elegantly designed bedrooms, a cozy living area, and a fully equipped kitchen. Guests can enjoy a private pool with a depth of 4 feet, a lush garden, and a terrace offering stunning ocean views, ideal for sunsets or morning coffee. Just 200 meters away from the beach, the property provides direct access to the sand. Modern amenities like air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, and on-site parking ensure a comfortable stay. The property is equipped with generator backup for power. A local app and local restaurants are available for food delivery.

name: Ocean Royal
description: Reunion Ocean Royal is a charming heritage villa with three bedrooms, offering essential amenities such as a refrigerator, AC, WiFi, and a gas stove. Situated just 50 meters from the beach, it provides easy access to the shore. The property is surrounded by coconut trees and other greenery, giving it the appearance of a farmhouse with expansive space. The villa also features generator backup to ensure a comfortable stay.

name: De Homes
description: Reunion Dehomes Premium Suites — where luxury meets convenience. Perfectly situated in the absolute center of Udupi city, our premium suites are located in close proximity to the sacred Udupi Sri Krishna Matha, offering the ideal blend of comfort, privacy, and modern living. Whether you are a devotee on a spiritual journey, a corporate professional, or a family on vacation, our beautifully designed spaces serve as your peaceful sanctuary in the middle of a vibrant city. Room categories include Standard Double Room, Standard Twin Room, Deluxe Double Room, Deluxe Double Room with Balcony, and Presidential Suite.

name: Ocean Daaffy
description: Reunion Ocean Daaffy is a 3-bedroom villa located just 100 meters from a pristine beach, offering the perfect coastal retreat. Equipped with essential amenities, the villa ensures both comfort and convenience, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility amidst nature. For added peace of mind, the property is backed by a reliable UPS power system.

name: Ocean Hridayam
description: Reunion Ocean Hridayam is a charming beachfront 2BHK villa thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience. The villa features one bedroom on the ground floor and another on the first floor, making it perfect for families and friends. The villa is equipped with all the basic amenities, including a kitchen with essential utensils to make your stay feel just like home. With reliable UPS power backup and a stunning beach-facing balcony on the first floor, you can unwind while enjoying the soothing sound of the waves and breathtaking views.

name: Ocean Bliss
description: Reunion Ocean Bliss is a 2BHK property with one common bathroom and all the basic amenities. Power backup is UPS. The beach is 800 meters away from the property. It is an open compound property offering a simple, peaceful retreat.

name: Marina Villa
description: Reunion Marina Villa is a 3BHK property located in the heart of Udupi city. The villa offers essential amenities including air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and parking space. A kitchen facility is also available. UPS power backup is available for uninterrupted stay.

name: Charm Villa
description: Reunion Charm Villa is a 3BHK property on the first floor with all the basic amenities. One of the bedrooms has an attached bathroom and one common bathroom is shared between the other two bedrooms. Power backup is UPS.

name: Aradhya Villa
description: Experience comfort and tranquility at our beautiful 4BHK property, thoughtfully designed to offer a perfect blend of space, convenience, and relaxation. Located in the heart of Udupi city yet tucked away in a peaceful neighborhood, it is an ideal destination for family get-togethers or group stays. The ground floor features a spacious living area, a well-equipped kitchen with basic utensils, and one comfortable bedroom with an attached bathroom. The first floor includes a cozy living space opening to a balcony and two well-furnished bedrooms, each with an attached bathroom. On the second floor, a luxurious bedroom with an attached bathroom featuring a bathtub offers a touch of indulgence. The closed terrace area is excellent for small family gatherings or celebrations. Located just 700 meters from the famous Udupi Krishna Temple and close to major tourist attractions and Udupi's best local cuisines.

name: Arya
description: Reunion Arya Studio Rooms are on the first floor. There are 2 independent 1BHKs with all the basic amenities. Power backup is UPS. The owner of the property stays nearby. Open parking is available right next to the compound.

name: Krshna
description: Krshna is a 2BHK property located in Manipal. The villa offers basic amenities, including a fully furnished kitchen, free WiFi, parking space, refrigerator, and more. The power backup is UPS.

name: Ocean Waves
description: Escape to the soothing waves and serene skies at our property by the beach. This property has 3 independent units — a 1BHK on the first floor and 2 independent one-bedroom halls on the ground floor. Each unit features a balcony, living area, bedroom, and attached bathroom with basic amenities like AC, geyser, mini fridge, microwave, and kettle. The beach is hardly 5 meters from the property — just cross the road and you're on the sand. Food delivery via Swiggy and Zomato is available, and home-made food can be delivered if pre-ordered. CCTV surveillance is in place for added security.

name: Regal Villa
description: Reunion Regal Villa is located in Udupi. This property offers access to a balcony, free private parking, and free WiFi. Leading onto a terrace, this air-conditioned villa comes with 2 separate bedrooms and a fully equipped kitchen. A flat-screen TV is featured. The nearest airport is Mangalore International Airport, 54 km from the villa.

name: Villa
description: Located in Udupi in the Karnataka region, Reunion Villa features a terrace and garden views. This property offers access to a balcony and free private parking. This air-conditioned villa comes with 3 bedrooms (2 AC + 1 non-AC), a TV, and an in-kitchen. The nearest International Airport is 43 km from the villa. Nearest beach is 8 km, nearest Temple/Church/Mosque is 2 km, and Manipal University is 5 km away. Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner (including Continental) can be arranged if ordered prior.

name: Reunion Ocean Café
description: Acclaimed as a premier coastal sanctuary, Reunion Ocean Café is situated immediately adjacent to the pristine shoreline of Mattu Beach in Udupi, Karnataka. Celebrated for its breathtaking sunset vistas over the Arabian Sea, this beachfront destination offers a serene ambiance where casual sophistication meets family-friendly warmth. Guests can relax in breezy outdoor seating areas directly facing the rolling waves, or unwind in a cozy lounge featuring a fireplace and live musical performances on select occasions. The culinary offerings showcase an elegant blend of continental and Chinese gastronomy, gourmet coastal snacks, artisanal burgers, fresh seafood, specialty coffees, and refreshing mocktails, complete with a dedicated selection of vegetarian and vegan creations. It is highly recommended for romantic candlelight dinners and memorable group gatherings.
amenities: Beach Birthday Celebrations & Small Private Events
